'''Quintarus Returyl''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] representative of the [[Spice mines of Kessel/Legends|Spice Mines of Kessel]]<ref name="Enslaved" /> and a [[Slaver/Legends|slaver]].<ref name="Enslaved-CC">{{WEGCite|book=Classic Campaigns|story=Rebel Enslaved!}}</ref> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], he purchased the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] [[Kentara]] from [[Harthusa]] on [[Deysum III]].<ref name="Enslaved" />
